scope: Compact audit of failed and conservatively refined classifiers. Model-label metrics and full-parser URL retrieval are separate. Later parser improvements need their own final report.

notes: Whole website families are partitioned before fitting. Vocabulary uses only terms shared across at least three training families.
Initial frozen breadth corpus was an evaluation set; train/validation portions became development data explicitly.
V1 nine-family test was disclosed after its failed comparison; later runs exclude it from model and routing selection.
The first external eight-family holdout became disclosed regression data after V2 failed. The second external holdout has not been used by these training tools.
Weak source-scope labels are not independently adjudicated gold.

v1.reason: Full replacement lost historical precision/recall despite improving new validation. Macro-only historical gating was insufficient.

selected.selection_metric: breadth validation site macro F1 with frozen gates

v2.reason: Unrestricted refinement failed first external evaluation and broader historical checks.

v3.reason: Group consistency reduced isolated rescues but lexical utility flags wrongly rejected sixteen valid historical archive links. Historical full-parser F1 declined.

runtime.limitations: Local developer-machine inference timings, with resident feature rows and warmed kernels. Concurrent work may affect timing. Tracemalloc excludes some native allocations; imported training libraries make total process RSS unsuitable as production-memory evidence. This evaluates classifier inference only, not HTML parsing or network latency. Scalar group inference intentionally differs from whole-page inference.

v4.status: passed original validation, failed first external regression with the parser then evaluated
v4.reason: Disabling expert rejection preserved historical positives, but a semantic table-role issue still admitted ten extra Yale links. No promotion claim.

full_parser_selection.selection: Frozen original validation cohorts only, highest breadth micro F1 among models passing every frozen cohort gate, lower rejection threshold breaks ties.

reproduction.inputs: The nine existing feature datasets named by V1 protocol, the frozen original baseline, existing inference/evaluation helpers, and pinned ML dependencies. Do not initialize replay from the newly deployed model.
reproduction.line_endings: Frozen raw protocol hashes are retained. input-provenance.json certifies only CRLF/LF equivalence, preserving all other bytes, order, labels, and split metadata.
reproduction.numerics: Input equivalence is exact; floating-point optimizers may not produce byte-identical artifacts on another platform. Recheck exported inference parity and all quality gates.
reproduction.full_parser_replay: Needs the ignored public HTML captures whose hashes are recorded in existing source manifests. Raw captures are not needed to replay classifier fitting.
